messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 02:14 UTC — High error rate on reranker-batch endpoint (svc: embeddings-rerank). Severity: P1. Paging on-call: @jordan.

jordan: seeing it, joining. Errors are exactly: downstream mismatch on vector dims + 400 from reranker. Pulling logs now.

ali: FYI customer impact: a small subset of requests to /v1/rerank/batch are returning 500s, about ~6% of traffic over last 10m. Some enterprise tenants report degraded search.

samira: got partial logs from the canary. stacktrace has `ValueError: expected vector length 1536 got 1280` from reranker.score(). Looks like an upstream embedder returned a different vector size.

devon: where did those 1280 embeddings come from? Any recent model swaps or quantized variants deployed?

jordan: no manual model swap in prod. Routing logs show these requests were routed to dedicated pool gp-small-02 in us-west-2 with model alias "open-embed-lite-q8" — that's a recent canary from last night.

matt: I see a canary rollout in the Dedicated config: model_variant=open-embed-lite-q8 on routing rule emb-low-latency. Rollout was 5% on 1978899000. Need to confirm if embedding vector shape changed in that variant.

samira: quick hypothesis: the q8 variant's tokenizer or head may be emitting 1280-d vectors instead of 1536 due to model config mismatch. If reranker assumes 1536, that would raise errors.

ali: customer impact note — affected requests tied to rerank flows that expect 1536-d vectors. Customers using embeddings-only endpoints unaffected.

jordan: mitigation plan: 1) pause the routing rule to stop sending new traffic to the q8 canary, 2) add soft fail in reranker to skip mismatched vectors and log counts, 3) collect all mismatched samples for offline analysis. Starting step 1 now.

ops-bot: action: routing-rule emb-low-latency paused by jordan at 02:22 UTC. Traffic will reroute to fallback embedder 1536-base.

devon: patching reranker to soft-fail in prod now (wrap vector length check, return partial results for those requests). Will push a small hotfix to reduce 500s while we investigate. ETA ~15m.

matt: tagging the affected deploy: canary id dc-embed-197889, owner=ml-onboarding. Adding to incident ticket 197890.

samira: gathering sample payloads for those 1280 vectors. If we can find origin (model binary or tokenizer), we can confirm shape delta. Can you dump last 500 hits from gp-small-02?

jordan: grabbing logs and will paste slices:

jordan: ```
[02:17:09] req_id=abc123 svc=embeddings-rank src=gp-small-02 model=open-embed-lite-q8 vector_len=1280
[02:17:12] req_id=def456 svc=embeddings-rank src=gp-small-02 model=open-embed-lite-q8 vector_len=1280
[02:18:02] req_id=ghi789 svc=embeddings-rank downstream=reranker err=ValueError: expected 1536 got 1280
```

ali: saved those to /var/incident/197890/sampled-logs.log and uploaded to incident doc.

devon: hotfix rolled out: reranker v2.3.17 with soft-fail is live on routing tier. 500s dropped to 0.5% within 3m. Observability shows errors rerouted to fallback model.

matt: coordinating with models team — pinging @ml-onboarding in their channel.

samira: while devon recovers user facing, I'll start timeline and hypothesis table here:
- 01:50 UTC: Dedicated pool gp-small-02 autoscaled up a node (normal).
- 01:58 UTC: ops instrument triggered canary rollout open-embed-lite-q8 to emb-low-latency at 5%.
- 02:14 UTC: incident-bot alerted high error rate on reranker-batch.
- 02:22 UTC: routing rule paused by jordan.
- 02:25 UTC: reranker soft-fail hotfix deployed by devon.

samira: hypotheses: [A] model variant produces smaller vectors (config change) — high confidence. [B] routing mislabeling (vectors truncated in network) — low confidence. [C] backwards-incompatible tokenizer change — medium confidence.

jordan: want to capture sample compare: can we compute checksum of embeddings from q8 vs 1536-base for identical inputs? If shapes differ it's clearly model issue.

devon: yes. I'm saving pairs for 200 requests to s3://redwood-incidents/197890/pairs.csv

matt: ml-onboarding responded: "we shipped q8 with a dimension reduction patch to speed inference — we thought reranker compatibility was toggled but maybe not." Owner: @ml-onboarding-team.

ali: customer comms draft: "We experienced degraded relevance for some search/rerank requests between 02:14-02:30 UTC due to a canary model emitting embeddings with unexpected shape. Mitigation applied and traffic routed to stable model. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with RCA." Any objections?

jordan: looks good. Note to include list of affected tenants (we have tokenized tenant ids in the incident doc).

samira: next steps captured: 1) full log extraction and vector sample dump (samira, jordan), 2) model artifact diff (matt + ml-onboarding), 3) fix release gating to ensure embedding shape validation in routing (devex + eng-platform), 4) RCA writeup and postmortem link.

devon: I ran a quick offline diff: q8 vectors are 1280-d but are not a truncation of 1536; the projection layer is different. Pushing this evidence to incident doc.

matt: opening a rollback request for q8 canary across Dedicated pools and adding a preflight check for embedding dims in the deployment pipeline.

ops-bot: action: rollback request queued by matt at 03:05 UTC for canary dc-embed-197889.

samira: adding timeline entries and copying log snippets into the RCA draft. Also adding a count: total affected requests ~12.2k, distinct tenants 7, largest tenant traffic impact ~0.8% of their requests.

ali: closing note for now: customer-facing mitigation complete, on-call to handoff to weekday SRE rotation. Jordan and Devon to prepare handoff notes.

jordan: I'll create a short handoff message in #oncall-handoff and attach the incident doc.

devon: leaving a runbook entry: ensure embed dimension check in reranker at parse time; fallback to stable model if mismatch > 0.1%.

matt: assigning RCA owner: samira. Target RCA doc due in 72 hours.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved -> status=mitigated by routing pause + reranker hotfix. Escalation closed at 03:15 UTC.

samira: adding final checklist items: collect full artifact diffs, confirm rollback of dc-embed-197889, verify long-tail telemetry for 48h, and prepare customer follow-ups.

jordan: thanks team. I'll post the handoff and include links to s3 artifacts and the incident board.

matt: TL;DR for postmortem header: canary model introduced incompatible embedding projection (1280 vs 1536) — routing rules lacked a pre-deploy shape check -> 6% error spike on reranker-batch -> mitigated by pausing canary and soft-fail hotfix.

ali: tagging this thread in the incident tracker and moving to RCA state.

samira: will compile the RCA and timeline into incident-197890-rca.md and attach. Thanks all.
